about_the_game:
Widget Warriors Demo

Widget Warriors is a unique desktop widget game where every keystroke becomes an attack. Whether you're working, browsing, or gaming, your warrior continues to fight enemies on your desktop in the background.

This demo provides a limited preview of the full game, allowing you to experience the core mechanics in a smaller scope.

Included in this demo:

  • 4 playable levels with increasing difficulty

  • 6 available skills (a mix of active and passive)

  • A small selection of preset, non-customizable characters

  • Core mechanic where each keypress triggers an attack

Not included in this demo:

  • Character customization options

  • Daily "Key of the Day" bonus events

  • Full skill tree and progression system

  • Boss battles and later-game content

This demo is intended to give players a brief look at the gameplay and main systems ahead of the full game's release.
